prospective_boundary: Only official Binance Launchpool announcements with canonical publication timestamps strictly after the Git commit timestamp that first contains this freeze file are eligible. No backfill of announcements at or before that commit timestamp is permitted.

eligible_event_definition.source: official Binance Support Launchpool announcement only
eligible_event_definition.event_identity: canonical Binance article code plus canonical publication timestamp

execution_rule_unchanged.cluster_rule: Adjacent eligible announcements separated by <=60 minutes belong to one information cluster; signal time is earliest canonical publication timestamp.
execution_rule_unchanged.entry: first fully available 15-minute BNBBTC bar open whose timestamp is strictly greater than signal_time
execution_rule_unchanged.exit: BNBBTC 15-minute bar open exactly 24 hours after entry timestamp
execution_rule_unchanged.overlap_rule: If a later cluster entry is strictly earlier than the active trade exit, suppress the later signal; no delayed replacement or stacking.

source_contract.event_source: official Binance Support/CMS public read-only pages or endpoints
source_contract.market_source: public read-only Binance Spot BNBBTC 15m data; provider archive/checksum preferred when available, otherwise public read-only klines with full timestamp/path audit

no_rescue: After any forward outcome is observed, do not alter horizon, pair, direction, clustering, event subset, costs, entry/exit, threshold, sample target, concentration gate, or promotion criteria. No historical data may be reopened to rescue the forward result.
